data.what_it_does: Provides Flutter specific utilities and integration for the Serverpod backend framework. It connects Flutter applications with Serverpod clients and handles connectivity features.
use_when: You are building a Flutter application that connects to a Serverpod backend.
avoid_when: You are not using Serverpod as your application backend.
strengths: Seamless integration with the Serverpod ecosystem.
weaknesses: Tightly coupled to the Serverpod backend framework.
